findings.title: fetchJson does not handle 401/403 auth errors with token refresh
findings.description: The fetchJson function throws ApiError for all non-ok responses but doesn't handle authentication failures (401/403) with token refresh logic. This will cause hard failures when JWT tokens expire.
findings.recommendation: Add token refresh logic in fetchJson for 401 responses, with a retry mechanism and proper logout redirect on 403 or failed refresh.

findings.title: API key exposed in WebSocket URL
findings.description: The ElevenLabs agentId is passed in the WebSocket URL query parameter which may be logged in server access logs, browser history, and network inspection tools.
findings.recommendation: Use token-based authentication with short-lived tokens from a backend proxy instead of exposing agentId in URL. Implement a backend endpoint that generates ephemeral tokens.

findings.title: ResolutionTimeline caseId hardcoded instead of dynamic
findings.description: The ResolutionTimeline component on the ChatPage receives a hardcoded caseId='RX-10482' instead of deriving it from the selected conversation or route params.
findings.recommendation: Pass dynamic caseId based on the active conversation or extract from URL params. The caseId should come from the conversation data or be passed as a prop from the parent.

findings.title: useTrace refetchInterval creates infinite polling when data is empty
findings.description: The refetchInterval callback returns 1000ms when data is empty (no trace data yet), causing constant polling even before a runId is active. This wastes resources and can hit rate limits.
findings.recommendation: Only enable refetchInterval when runId is valid and data exists. Return false when no data is available to prevent polling on empty state.

findings.title: Canvas visualizer runs continuous animation even when not needed
findings.description: The animateVisualizer function uses requestAnimationFrame in a continuous loop whenever state is not 'idle', creating unnecessary CPU/GPU usage. The audio level history is updated every frame.
findings.recommendation: Throttle the visualizer to 30fps max using setTimeout or use a more efficient visualization approach. Consider using CSS animations for simple visualizers.

findings.title: Client-side filtering duplicates server-side filtering
findings.description: The component fetches filtered handoffs from the server via useHandoffs(filters, sort) but then applies additional client-side search filtering, causing redundant computation and potential inconsistencies.
findings.recommendation: Move search filtering to the server by adding search param to useHandoffs query, or remove client-side filtering if server already handles it. Currently both run, doubling the work.

findings.title: Duplicate trace components: Trace.tsx and TraceTimeline.tsx
findings.description: Two nearly identical trace components exist (Trace.tsx and TraceTimeline.tsx) with overlapping functionality. TraceTimeline is more feature-rich but Trace is still used in TracePage as fallback.
findings.recommendation: Consolidate into a single Trace component. Use TraceTimeline as the primary implementation and remove the simpler Trace component, or make Trace a lightweight wrapper.

findings.title: Hardcoded mock data instead of API integration
findings.description: The OperationsDashboardPage uses hardcoded CASES_DATA array instead of fetching real data from the API. This makes the dashboard non-functional in production.
findings.recommendation: Replace hardcoded data with useHandoffs or a new dashboard-specific API hook. The data should come from real backend endpoints.

findings.title: Hardcoded mock handoff data instead of API integration
findings.description: HandoffPage uses hardcoded HANDOFF_ITEMS array instead of fetching real handoff data. The page also has hardcoded approve/takeover logic that doesn't call real APIs.
findings.recommendation: Replace with useHandoffs and useHandoff hooks. Wire up handleApproveAction and handleTakeover to useAcceptHandoff and useCompleteHandoff mutations from api.ts.

findings.title: Hardcoded case data instead of API integration
findings.description: CaseDetailPage has all case details, notes, actions, policies, and customer profile hardcoded. No API calls are made to fetch real case data.
findings.recommendation: Create useCaseDetail hook in api.ts that fetches case data by ID. Replace all hardcoded data with real API responses.

findings.title: Hardcoded trace data instead of API integration
findings.description: TracePage uses SAMPLE_TRACE_STEPS hardcoded array instead of fetching real trace data from the API. The Trace component at the bottom is hidden and never used.
findings.recommendation: Use useTrace or useAgentRunTrace hooks to fetch real trace data. Remove hardcoded sample data and show the real Trace component.

findings.title: Hardcoded evaluation data with mock run logic
findings.description: EvaluationsPage uses hardcoded EVAL_SUITES array and a mock setTimeout for 'running' evaluations. No real API integration for evaluation runs.
findings.recommendation: Create evaluation API hooks (useEvaluations, useRunEvaluation) and replace mock data with real API calls.

findings.title: Missing ARIA labels for chat message containers
findings.description: Chat message bubbles lack proper ARIA roles (role='log' or role='status') and aria-live regions for screen reader announcements of new messages.
findings.recommendation: Add role='log' aria-live='polite' to the message container. Each message should have appropriate ARIA attributes for screen readers.

findings.title: Voice button lacks proper accessible name when state changes
findings.description: The voice button uses aria-label that changes with state but doesn't announce state changes to screen readers. Users won't know when listening starts/stops.
findings.recommendation: Add aria-live='polite' region that announces state changes, or use a separate visually-hidden status element with aria-live.

findings.title: Sidebar navigation links lack active state announcement
findings.description: Active navigation items use visual styling (border-left, background) but no ARIA current='page' attribute to indicate current page to screen readers.
findings.recommendation: Add aria-current='page' to the active Link component for screen reader users.

findings.title: Input error message not properly associated via aria-describedby
findings.description: The error message has an id but the input's aria-describedby references it correctly. However, the error element lacks role='alert' for immediate screen reader announcement.
findings.recommendation: Add role='alert' to the error paragraph for immediate announcement when error appears.

findings.title: CollapsibleSection re-renders all children on every toggle
findings.description: The CollapsibleSection component doesn't memoize its children, causing all nested components (EvidenceCard, PolicyExcerptCard, CompletedActionCard) to re-render on every expand/collapse.
findings.recommendation: Wrap CollapsibleSection children in React.memo or use the Radix Collapsible's built-in optimization. Consider extracting child components with memo.

findings.title: useHandoffs queryKey includes filter/sort objects causing cache misses
findings.description: The queryKey for useHandoffs includes the entire filters and sort objects. Since new objects are created on each render, this causes unnecessary cache misses and refetches.
findings.recommendation: Serialize filters/sort to a stable string or use a custom queryKey factory that creates stable keys. Use JSON.stringify or a hash function.

findings.title: ApiError class not exported for use in error boundaries
findings.description: ApiError is defined but only exported at the bottom. Error boundaries and components can't easily catch and type-check API errors without importing the class.
findings.recommendation: Export ApiError as a named export at the top of the file. Consider adding error codes and more structured error info for better handling.

findings.title: Potential XSS via message content rendering
findings.description:
Message content is rendered directly via {msg.content} in a

tag with whitespace-pre-wrap. If content contains HTML/script tags from untrusted sources, it could execute.
findings.recommendation: Sanitize message content before rendering. Use a library like DOMPurify or ensure backend sanitizes all message content. At minimum, render as textContent not innerHTML.

findings.title: JSON.stringify of evidence data could expose sensitive info
findings.description: EvidenceCard uses JSON.stringify on evidence.data which may contain PII, tokens, or sensitive information that shouldn't be displayed in the UI.
findings.recommendation: Filter sensitive fields before displaying evidence data. Create a sanitize function that removes known sensitive keys (passwords, tokens, PII).

findings.title: Audio processor uses deprecated ScriptProcessorNode
findings.description: The ElevenLabs client uses createScriptProcessor which is deprecated in favor of AudioWorklet. This may cause issues in future browser versions.
findings.recommendation: Migrate to AudioWorklet for audio processing. This provides better performance and is the modern standard.

findings.title: WebSocket reconnection logic doesn't reset state properly
findings.description: On reconnection attempts, the client doesn't clean up the previous WebSocket properly and may leave dangling connections. The reconnect logic uses setTimeout without clearing on unmount.
findings.recommendation: Add proper cleanup in a useEffect return or disconnect method. Track reconnection timeout IDs and clear them on component unmount or explicit disconnect.

findings.title: Collapsible component is just a re-export without customization
findings.description: The collapsible.tsx simply re-exports Radix primitives without any project-specific styling, behavior, or TypeScript enhancements. Adds indirection without value.
findings.recommendation: Either remove the wrapper and import Radix directly, or add project-specific defaults (className, animations, etc.) to justify the abstraction.

findings.title: Tooltip component is just a re-export without customization
findings.description: Same as Collapsible - tooltip.tsx re-exports Radix Tooltip without any customization. Adds unnecessary abstraction layer.
findings.recommendation: Remove wrapper or add project-specific styling/behavior defaults.

findings.title: formatJson called on every render for CopyButton
findings.description: The formatJson function is called during render for each trace event's CopyButton, causing JSON serialization on every render even when not copying.
findings.recommendation: Memoize the formatted JSON with useMemo or compute it only when the copy button is clicked (lazy evaluation).

findings.title: Missing error boundary around Chat component
findings.description: The Chat component is rendered without a dedicated error boundary. If Chat crashes, the entire page crashes instead of showing a graceful fallback.
findings.recommendation: Wrap Chat component in an ErrorBoundary with a chat-specific fallback (e.g., 'Failed to load chat, retry').

findings.title: No request/response interceptors for logging or auth
findings.description: The fetchJson function has no interceptors for request/response logging, auth header injection, or global error handling. Each mutation/query handles errors individually.
findings.recommendation: Create a centralized API client with interceptors for auth tokens, logging, and global error handling. Use a library like ky or create a wrapper.

findings.title: No TypeScript types for ElevenLabs message events
findings.description: The handleMessage function uses 'unknown' type and casts to a loose object structure. No proper TypeScript interfaces for ElevenLabs WebSocket message types.
findings.recommendation: Define proper TypeScript interfaces for all ElevenLabs message types (user_transcript, agent_response, agent_response_end, error) for type safety.

findings.title: Timeline steps lack keyboard navigation
findings.description: Timeline step nodes are clickable divs with onClick handlers but aren't focusable or keyboard accessible (no tabIndex, no onKeyDown for Enter/Space).
findings.recommendation: Add tabIndex={0}, role='button', and onKeyDown handlers for Enter/Space to make timeline steps keyboard navigable.

findings.title: Theme initialization race condition with SSR
findings.description: The theme uses useEffect to read localStorage and set initial theme, causing a flash of wrong theme on hydration. No SSR-compatible theme detection.
findings.recommendation: Use a script in index.html to set theme before React hydrates, or use next-themes pattern with suppressHydrationWarning and client-side only rendering.

findings.title: Search input state not connected to any search functionality
findings.description: The header search input has local state (searchQuery) but no onSearch callback or connection to any search API. It's a non-functional UI element.
findings.recommendation: Either implement global search functionality with a search API hook, or remove the search input if not needed.

summary: The ResolveX frontend has a well-structured codebase with modern React patterns (React Query, Radix UI, Tailwind v4, TypeScript strict mode). However, critical issues exist: most pages use hardcoded mock data instead of real API integration, making them non-functional in production. Security concerns include exposed API keys in WebSocket URLs and potential XSS via unsanitized message rendering. Performance issues include unnecessary re-renders, continuous canvas animations, and inefficient query keys. Accessibility gaps exist in keyboard navigation, ARIA attributes, and screen reader announcements. Architecture has duplicate components (Trace/TraceTimeline) and over-abstracted UI wrappers. Priority: 1) Replace all hardcoded data with real API hooks, 2) Fix auth token handling and WebSocket security, 3) Address XSS and sensitive data exposure, 4) Consolidate duplicate components, 5) Improve accessibility.
